findings.issue: Unrelated formatting churn: a BOM was added to line 1 and unrelated lines were reindented (catalogtypes/catalogbrands handlers, BadRequest/NotFound initializers), which adds noise to the diff.
The [ProducesResponseType<ProblemDetails>(400)] attribute is now redundant with the Results<Created, ValidationProblem> return type and describes a different schema than the one actually returned.
The existence check and the save are not atomic, so concurrent creates with the same new id can still hit the primary key violation and return 500.
The 409 attribute declares application/problem+json, but TypedResults.Conflict<ProblemDetails> serializes as application/json (the generated OpenAPI says application/json).
